- Cross-region deployment of Lambda/API Gateway

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
```

```yaml
Resources:
  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
```

## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical, beginner-friendly AWS DevOps pipeline combining ECS Fargate, CodePipeline, and CodeDeploy canary with minimal CloudFormation; validates health checks and rollback plan.

## Key Concepts

- ECS Fargate deployment and task definitions

- CodeDeploy canary strategy on ECS
- ALB health checks and target groups
- Minimal CloudFormation IaC; IAM least privilege

## Code Example

```yaml
# Minimal CloudFormation fragment (high-level)
Resources:
  MyCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
  MyTaskDef:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: api
          Image: !Sub "${RepoUri}:latest"
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 3000
  MyService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref MyCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref MyTaskDef
      LoadBalancers:
        - ContainerName: api
          ContainerPort: 3000
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref MyTG
  MyTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      VpcId: vpc-xxxxx
```

## Why This Is Asked

Tests disaster recovery in AWS with a beginner-friendly cross-region flow and DNS-based failover.

## Key Concepts

- Cross-region artifact replication
- Route 53 health checks and failover routing
- Minimal CloudFormation for multi-region setups
- CI/CD coordination across regions
- Safe failover testing and rollback

## Code Example

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  EastHealthCheck:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: HTTP
        FullyQualifiedDomainName: api-east.example.com
        Port: 80
        ResourcePath: /
        Interval: 30
        FailureThreshold: 3
  EastRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      Name: api.example.com
      Type: A
      SetIdentifier: East
      Failover: PRIMARY
      TTL: 60
      HealthCheckId: !Ref EastHealthCheck
  WestHealthCheck:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: HTTP
```
